title: scandix divaricata
intro: Scandix divaricata, commonly known as Wild Fennel or Divaricate Scandix, is a flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion.
